title: Superadditivity of local mass over a finite pairwise disjoint family (step 9)
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, let U ⊆ Euclid P be any set, and let S be an n-current in U (GeometricCurrentOn U n). Let ι be a type, s a finite subset of ι, and N : ι → Set (Euclid P) with N_i ∩ N_j = ∅ for all distinct i, j ∈ s. Then Σ_{i∈s} M_{N_i}(S) ≤ M_{⋃_{i∈s} N_i}(S) in [0, ∞]. Here M_W(S) = S.massOn W is the supremum of ofReal(S ω) over the test n-forms ω in U (TestFormOn U n) with tsupport ω ⊆ W and covectorEuclideanNorm(ω(x)) ≤ 1 for all x (Simon 6.2.5).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (S : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (ι : Type) (s : Finset ι) (N : ι → Set (Euclid P)), (↑s : Set ι).PairwiseDisjoint N → ∑ i ∈ s, S.massOn (N i) ≤ S.massOn (⋃ i ∈ s, N i)
